title: Orchestrator Manifest
description: Declares what resources this RPA project needs in UiPath Orchestrator. Place as orchestrator-manifest.json in your project root.

project.description: Project name — used for logging and correlation.

folderPath.description: Orchestrator folder path (e.g. 'Finance/Invoicing'). Created automatically if it does not exist.

assets.description: Assets to sync. Missing assets are created; changed assets are updated; assets not listed here are removed from Orchestrator.

perEnvironment.description: Per-tenant overrides. Keys are tenant names (dev/test/stage/prod).

packages.description: NuGet packages (.nupkg) to upload. Glob patterns are supported for the path field.

path.description: Relative path or glob pattern to the .nupkg file (e.g. 'output/*.nupkg').

autoVersion.description: If true, automatically appends a -cicd.N suffix when the version already exists in Orchestrator.

libraries.description: Library packages (.nupkg) to upload to the tenant library feed.

path.description: Relative path or glob pattern to the library .nupkg file.

processes.description: Process (Release) definitions to create or update in Orchestrator.

packageId.description: The NuGet package ID this process runs.
